r: Great learning book for my kid. The touch-to-sound feature works well and keeps them engaged — 200+ words across daily themes is really helpful for vocabulary. Bright pages, safe rounded edges, and rechargeable is a plus. Loves using it

This interactive leveled reading book is a massive hit! The progression of the reading levels is thoughtfully structured, making it easy to match a child's current reading ability while gently encouraging them to grow and build confidence.

The interactive elements—whether touch features or audio prompts—keep kids actively involved in the story rather than just passively listening or reading. The illustrations are vibrant, colorful, and captivating, holding their attention from start to finish. A fantastic tool for early literacy and a wonderful gift for young readers!

Such a great education book to help kids learn to read. They also help with letters, songs, sight words, and soon your little one will be reading stories. Book is rechargeable and comes with press features that help your child learn.

Great Learning Resource for Little Readers! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I love how this book combines learning with fun! It includes 17 leveled reading stories, letter recognition, sight words, CVC words, common phrases, and even children’s songs. I also love that it incorporates different learning activities to help keep little ones engaged.

The colorful illustrations are inviting, and I appreciate that the book is designed to help children build their reading skills gradually. It’s a great resource to add to our homeschool learning materials, especially for early readers.

Overall, I’m excited to incorporate this into our learning routine! A great option for little learners ages 3 and up. ❤️
